items.title: Dipke's first response to the 5-day custody order: dares Modi to 'declare an Emergency'
items.summary: CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke issued his first reaction to the SEM Mandir Marg custody order via his verified X account @abhijeet_dipke (post dated 8:50 AM IST, Oct 14; screenshot reposted to his IG @abhijeetdipke with caption 'Coward.', ~13.6K likes). He says 'Ashu' and 'Saurav' were sent to 5 days' judicial custody for 'unfurling tricolour at Jantar Mantar,' and directly challenges PM Narendra Modi to 'show some guts' and officially declare an Emergency instead of using 'cowardly tactics' to crush dissent. Note: his post names only Das and Ranka (2 of the 3) — Shinde's custody status rests on the SAAM TV/VOB graphics alone. Self-published leader statement; no second outlet yet covering the post itself.
